assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are suggestive of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are of a paroxysmal nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
The service captures and characterizes the arrhythmic events
The diagnosis code I49.5 is specified
The diagnosis code I49.9 is specified
The service directly addresses the clinical indication for continuous rhythm monitoring required to diagnose the underlying sick sinus syndrome and unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
